correctness.rationale: The final claim quantifies over every positive integer n for the fixed odd prime 971. First, 971 is prime. The known recurrence e_n=(n-1)e_{n-1}-e_{n-2}+1-(-1)^n with e1=e2=1 has period dividing 1942 modulo 971: the coefficients/forcing are 1942-periodic, and independent modular recurrence verifies e_{1943}=e1=e_{1944}=e2=1. Independent iteration on the entire first period yields exactly the three zero residues {388,1554,1942}; all odd indices are thereby excluded by a *finite exhaustive* modular lemma. Second, Givens–Moll 2020 establishes e_{2m}=m A(m), A(m)=Σ_{j=0}^{m-1} Π_{l=1}^{j}(m²-l²). For every integer m>0 and j≥971, Π contains two p-divisible factors at l=r,971-r if m≡r≠0 mod p, or the p²-divisible factor at l=971 if m≡0 mod p; for m<971 the added terms vanish exactly at l=m. Thus A(m) ≡ S(m) mod p² for fixed S(t)=Σ_{j=0}^{970}Π_{l=1}^{j}(t²-l²). Third, independent integer evaluation finds S(194)=S(777)=S(194+971)=S(777+971)=459283=971·473 mod 971², so Taylor expansion forces S'(194)=S'(777)=0 mod 971. Hence A(m) is exactly valuation one for all m≡194 or 777 mod p; both m are p-units so e_{2m} has valuation one. For m≡0 mod p, A(m)≡S(0)=Σ_{j=0}^{970}(-1)^j(j!)²≡383 mod 971, a p-unit; e_{2m} thus has valuation ν_p(m)=ν_p(2m). Remaining classes have valuation 0 by the one-period census. The root classes each have density 1/(2p), and ν_p(n) on multiples of 2p has distribution (p-1)/(2p^{k+1}) at k≥1. This yields P(V=0)=1-3/(2p), P(V=1)=1/p+(p-1)/(2p²), and P(V=k)=(p-1)/(2p^{k+1}) for k≥2. Tonelli/floor-count bounds give the mean 1/p+Σ_{k≥1}1/(2p^k)=1/p+1/(2(p-1)); the infinite tail is bounded by a convergent geometric series. The finite experiments are NOT treated as the infinite proof, which depends on the product congruence and complete period.
residual_risks: Proof incorporates a finite exhaustive computation to certify the 1942-root set; all possible residues are enumerated, but this is not a symbolic closed-form factorization.
The mod-971³ test through 1,885,682 terms alone is insufficient for an all-n theorem; infinite conclusion rests on congruence proof.
Finite checks do not establish absolute priority; no external formal proof or expert attestation is asserted.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge PASS for the complete all-positive-index 971-adic valuation law, not for the 2026 discovery of the terminal 388 branch, the general product identity, or the subsequently published full even-nonzero-root profile. The 2020 primary paper already proves recurrence/product forms and 2p periodicity, and the 2026 Flórez–Higuita-Diaz–Ramírez primary paper proves terminality at 388. A closely overlapping published Resultary record, "The least prime with a nonsimple even FiboLaplace valuation branch is 971", already determines both nonzero even internal roots 388 and 1554 and proves their terminality. That is expressly credited: those pieces are covered prior findings, regardless of different title. The remaining separately verified statement excludes ALL odd roots modulo 971, handles the distinguished zero residue with a 383-unit calculation, assembles a complete all-index valuation function and proves exact distributions and mean. The prior published even-branch theorem expressly disclaims coverage of odd and distinguished classes; the 2020/2026 primary papers do not supply this complete 971-specific consequence. New work is narrow but mathematically nontrivial as a total prime-specific classification. Unindexed literature and implicit deductions from prior formulas remain historical-priority risks.
residual_risks: Another published result on the same day already covers the two terminal nonzero even classes; this work must be credited as a narrower all-index classification, not the discovery of those roots.
The added odd nonroot census and β(971)=383 calculation are finite exact computations; mathematical value is the complete natural invariant, not originality of trivial geometric density counting.
OEIS A003470 was blocked (403); an unindexed database, older notes or derivation from other results could cover the same complete law.
The relevant full arXiv primary paper and Givens–Moll paper were accessible, but historical priority outside these inspections cannot be certified.

value.rationale: Prime 971 is not arbitrarily selected: it is the first known odd-prime counterexample to simplicity of even FiboLaplace valuation branches, and published work established the exact two terminal even residues. The full exact valuation distribution on *all* n, including a proof that no odd root exists, the distinguished unbounded branch, each valuation density and the natural mean, is a complete structural invariant of that exceptionally motivated sequence. A future user of this exceptional tree can use the exact root support and frequencies rather than extrapolate from even-branch data. The new theorem is narrow and substantially uses previously published machinery and roots, but a complete naturally posed exact invariant is worthwhile; no general all-prime theorem or independent novelty of the elementary density summation is claimed.
residual_risks: Value is confined to one motivated exceptional prime; previous work covers a substantial portion of the root profile.
The exact elementary density expressions follow routinely once the new complete valuation function is available; those corollaries alone would not justify novelty or value.
